description: Which infrastructure.yml keys feed which ARM parameter of Microsoft's quickstart templates. Read by scripts/common/arm-deployment/AzlArmDeploymentRun.psm1 to fail with the key name when a required value is missing, and to print the mapping in the plan. The code that builds the values is New-AzlArmParameterSet in AzlArmDeployment.psm1; the tests check that every parameter of every template in template-parameters.json has an entry here.

fields.keys: infrastructure.yml paths the value comes from (dotted; [] is every list element). Empty when the value is a constant or comes from somewhere else (see source).
fields.source: Optional. Where else the value comes from: handoff (the ZTP handoff), osreport (the OS configuration report), sbe (the SBE folder), tenant (looked up in the directory), constant, derived (computed from the keys).
fields.required: true: an empty value is an input error that names the keys.
fields.requiredWhen: Required only when every given path has the given value (scenario choices).
fields.requiredKeys: The keys checked when the parameter is required. Default: the keys without [] .
fields.secret: true: the value is a keyvault:// reference, never a value.

deploymentMode.note: Set by the run: Validate or Deploy.

witnessType.note: cloud gives Cloud, anything else No Witness. Two nodes need a cloud witness.

AzureStackLCMAdminPasssword.note: Three s: the name as the Microsoft template for the sovereign cloud spells it.

hciResourceProviderObjectID.note: Looked up in the directory when the key is empty (needs permission to read the resource provider's service principal).

arcNodeResourceIds.note: The handoff's arcMachineResourceId per node; else the Arc machine named after the node in azure.resource_group.

configurationMode.note: Default express for S2D, infra_only for a SAN.

subnetMask.note: The prefix length turned into a mask.

networkingType.note: singleServerDeployment for one node, switchlessMultiServerDeployment or switchedMultiServerDeployment.

intentList.note: Adapter names are the OS names, found by MAC through the OS configuration report.

infraVolLunId.note: A LUN number is translated to the disk's UniqueId by the OS configuration report.

nodes.note: iSCSI template only: one object per node with its Arc ID, address, initiator name and iSCSI ports (the ports with the role iscsi:a or iscsi:b).

chapType.note: iSCSI template only: None, OneWay or Mutual.

partnerProperties.note: Name and value pairs the hardware vendor's SBE asks for. Sent only when an SBE is configured (hardware.sbe.version); an empty list when the file names none.

partnerCredentiallist.note: Secrets the hardware vendor's SBE needs, each as secretName and secretValue (the secret reference in the file is read on this machine when the deployment is submitted). The template writes secretValue into the cluster's Key Vault under secretName. The value passes through this plain array parameter, so it is visible in the deployment's input parameters in Azure. Sent only when an SBE is configured (hardware.sbe.version); an empty list when the file names none.

nodes.note: Only the iSCSI template, which is not generated yet.

chapType.note: iSCSI template only; not generated yet.

chapUsername.note: iSCSI template only; not generated yet.

chapCredential.note: iSCSI template only; not generated yet.
